title: unified-rollouts-probing-canary-shadow-autorollback-workflow
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: improve safety and observability for canary + shadow rollouts by adding a probing stage that exercises a quarantine quorum and triggers automated rollback on composite metric regressions. This PR implements a probing stage in the unified rollouts workflow so new variants receive limited live traffic probes that evaluate latency, error-rate, and semantic-quality (via lightweight eval hooks) before allocations increase. The probing stage supports quarantine scoring (metric quorum across probes), conditional weight increases, and automatic rollback when configured thresholds breach.

What this PR changes: consolidated controller logic and a new workflow state machine for 'probing' between shadow and canary stages; add configurable quorum rules and metric aggregation; implement lightweight probe runner that samples requests and optionally replays synthetic probes; integrate with observability to emit probing metrics and alerts; add e2e tests and stability guards.

Files of interest and high-level summary: see files_changed for details. Key behavioral changes: 1) rollout policy now supports 'probing' as an optional stage with parameters: probe_size, quorum_threshold, probe_interval, max_probe_duration, and probe_fallback_policy. 2) autorollback engine extended to evaluate composite metrics across probing and canary windows; supports weighted quorums and time-decay. 3) observability hooks added (rollout.probe.start/complete, rollout.probe.quarantine_event, rollout.probe.metric_quorum) to power dashboards and alerts. 4) added canary shadow pairing helpers so shadow traffic can be elevated to probing without impacting user-visible allocation until probes pass.

Testing and rollout plan: unit tests for rule evaluation, e2e integration against a local canary harness, and staged cluster runs in perf-canary. We ran two cluster-level test runs in perf-canary: run-2026-02-23 and run-2026-02-25. Both indicated stable probe aggregation and one false-positive quarantine (expected, addressed by tuning quorum_threshold default). Rollout plan: feature-flag behind controlled gate, enable on staging for 48h with synthetic probing traffic, then gradual opt-in to canary workflows for internal teams before wider rollout.

Related work: builds on ENG-1790 (probe metrics design) and ENG-1864 (autorollback refactor). Addresses SUP-4212 incident follow-up.

Checklist:
- [x] Controller state machine and API schema
- [x] Probe runner and sampling logic
- [x] Quorum and composite metric evaluation
- [x] Observability events and dashboards
- [x] Unit + integration tests
- [x] E2E tests in perf-canary

Notes: this PR intentionally keeps probe runner lightweight (no heavy model evals) to avoid significant cost at probe scale; downstream teams can opt into heavier semantic probes via config.
